title: open mp4 clips in editor

commit.merge_subject: merge: open mp4 clips in editor

description:
The editor opens both clip kinds through the seam: ClipEditorScreen's
session is typed EditorPreviewSession and opens via PreviewSessions
(routed by SourcePathDecision.decide on the stored kind with the
container mime as the rescue for pre-detection imports), so the render
pump, transport and playback loop never branch on clip kind — an
imported Mi-Log MP4 gets the same preview, grade controls and
play/pause/seek as an MCRAW clip.

- AppNav passes sourceKind (stored SourceKind, MCRAW default) and
  sourceMime (ContentResolver.getType, null on failure) to the editor.
- The open effect keys on sourcePath too, so a routing change re-opens.
- The fd discipline is the factory's business now: the inline
  closeFdQuietly calls are gone from the screen.
- The per-render fallback stays MCRAW-only (PreviewRenderer.render reads
  the RAW pipeline); an encoded clip without a session fails with the
changed: feat: editor preview seam for encoded clips
feat: open mp4 clips in editor
